claims: Receptionist answers, offers availability (Tue 9 / 11:30 / 2), books 11:30, captures 2017 BMW 340i, lists services (SOS fix, reverse lamp, charge pipe + front grill install, fluids/modules check), texts confirmation mid-call asking for the part link, discloses it is an AI when asked, hangs up on its own
Built in about 30 minutes with Claude Code and Bland AI
Local businesses miss calls all day; an AI agency could sell this build for ~$2,000 plus ~$500/month retainer
Entire build, workflow, GitHub repo, Notion page and Loom walkthrough are free for commenters
how_to_steps: Design a Bland AI conversational pathway: Greeting -> Offer Availability -> Caller + Vehicle -> Capture Service List -> Text VIN + Parts -> Wrap Up -> Confirm + End, with global nodes AI Disclosure and Transfer to Human
Use Claude Code to generate/configure the pathway and supporting workflow (send SMS mid-call, calendar booking)
Test by calling the number; agent books slot and texts confirmation
Package as a service for local shops ($2k build + $500/mo)

relevance.why: A concrete, demonstrably working voice-agent product with a clear local-business sales pitch; for a founder who builds businesses with Claude Code this is a sellable offer or a feature for existing apps (booking).

implement_score.why: Feasible in a day using Bland's pathway builder plus Claude Code for the glue; the hard part is sales/ops (phone numbers, calendar integration, per-minute Bland cost, handling edge cases), not the build. Worth a weekend prototype if a service-business niche is in reach.
